notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table entries; no metric conversion performed. N (R) is retained as named, with exclusions unknown. Primary table URL https://osf.io/7rtcz/; assigned locator https://osf.io/gxvd3. Known locator discrepancy: assigned https://osf.io/gxvd3/ identifies the Campbell and Robert multiplication-memory project in the primary table (Study Num 13), whereas the matching Marsh/Vachon/Jones outcome is Study Num 12 at https://osf.io/7rtcz/. Values retained from the independently matched Marsh primary-table row; supplied project URL does not match.
Source follow-up: Original published article title and DOI match the assigned reference. Selected the instruction type × sound condition interaction because the neutral description compares the disruption across free and serial recall. The locator identifies only a page; the same page also reports a free-recall simple comparison (t(23) = 3.94, p < .001, d = 1.64) and a serial-recall simple comparison (t(23) < 1.00, p = .53, d = 0.30). These are distinct tests and were not combined with the selected interaction. The ANOVA includes the quiet condition as well as the similar/dissimilar conditions. Reported success is unassigned for this original-only validation.
